GAB.note: Nothing stated on rules or an authority against AI harms.
Only possible cooperation with China on robotics and AI for public services; no government AI system stated.
Robotics visit and possible health applications only; no sectoral AI tool piloted or in service.

facts.fact: Gabon is preparing its first national AI strategy; work in September 2026 with UNDP support identified 22 challenges and made 36 recommendations, and the strategy has yet to be formalised and adopted.

GAB.note: Only prospective cooperation with China on training and technology transfer; no model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in Gabon.
